value.rationale: A substantive market-diffusion problem asks how to sequence a fixed inventory of campaigns varying in relative innovation and imitation effects. The result gives one sharp ratio order simultaneously optimizing every final adoption threshold, not only mean adoption, and a non-obvious exact boundary: the probability of one or more adopters is completely order-invariant while every higher threshold improves strictly for two differently ranked phases. It also handles any finite number of phases and population sizes without continuous-control assumptions. This remains mathematically motivated even without empirical validation.
